# Local browser dependencies

Pinned upstream distributions: Papa Parse 5.5.3 (MIT), Lucide 0.468.0 (ISC).
FullCalendar 6.1.15 (MIT), including its zh-cn locale, provides month/week calendars.
These are served locally. No CDN is contacted by the running application.
Source packages: https://registry.npmjs.org/papaparse and https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide
